definitions.gloss: Year of the Tiger (in the zodiac)
definitions.explanation: The Year of the Tiger, one of the twelve years of the Chinese/Japanese zodiac ({十二支|じゅうにし}). A person born in such a year is said to be 'a tiger.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寅年|とらどし}だ。
examples.english: Next year is the Year of the Tiger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寅年|とらどし}⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧です。
examples.english: I was born in the Year of the Tiger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{寅年|とらどし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ちなんで→ちなむ：10386_chinamu⟧⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧⟦{虎|とら}→虎：02228_tora⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦イラスト→イラスト：10717_irasuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いた→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
examples.english: On my New Year's cards I drew a cute tiger illustration in honor of the Year of the Tiger.

notes:
One of the twelve zodiac years (⟦{十二支|じゅうにし}→十二支：27602_juunishi⟧); the tiger is the third sign. People often mention their zodiac year as an indirect way of referring to their age.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寅年|とらどし}⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧: born in the Year of the Tiger
- ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寅年|とらどし}: this year is the Year of the Tiger

USAGE:
The zodiac uses the special kanji {寅|とら} rather than the everyday ⟦{虎|とら}→虎：02228_tora⟧ for 'tiger,' though both are read とら.
